Flavors Made for Royalty

Hosting an event shouldn’t be stressful. At Book My Chef, we make it effortless. Choose from our all-inclusive catering packages designed for every occasion—whether it’s a traditional North Indian wedding, a corporate lunch, or a festive Diwali dinner. Our chefs craft menus that celebrate India’s diverse culinary heritage while also offering global cuisines for modern tastes. With us, every event becomes an unforgettable culinary journey.

Services

Add On Services

To make your event completely stress-free, we offer additional support services that ensure everything runs smoothly. Add these to your booking at checkout for a truly seamless experience.

Bartenders

Professional bartenders serving premium cocktails and refreshing mocktails to keep the party alive.

Waiters

Experienced waitstaff to ensure your guests are served with warmth and efficiency throughout the event.

cleaners

Our trained cleaning staff ensures your space is spotless after the celebration, so you can relax and enjoy.
